text: My main symptom is Aggressive cough with thick, yellow-green sputum. I also have Cough worse in the morning, History of recurrent bronchitis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis.

The clinical picture of a chronic productive cough with copious purulent sputum in a non-smoker is highly characteristic of this condition. The images I requested earlier should confirm the presence of dilated airways and bronchial wall thickening.
